tier_rationale: SSNs and bank accounts of about 168,000 associates; moves about $1.45 million weekly; supports BP-01, BP-11, BP-12
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter; review of opinion, scope, subservice organizations, exceptions, and complementary user entity controls (CUECs); SOC 1 for the financial audit
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; payroll bank (ACH origination) carved out
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 sampled vendor-side bank file changes lacked second approval; remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User provisioning and quarterly review; MFA; review of bank-change and register export reports; approval of payroll registers. Mapped to AC-2, AC-5, AU-6, IA-2(1). Firm gaps: bank-change review (POAM-006), payroll role split (POAM-021)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 h, RPO 1 h; BIA BP-01 needs RTO 24 h, RPO 4 h: meets the BIA. A multi-day vendor ransomware event is outside the stated objectives (P08 payroll outage runbook)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting firm data
follow_up: Agree written bank-change freeze and session revocation procedure (POAM-012); add a standing ACH origination fallback (POAM-011)
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Director of Payroll and Billing, 2026-09-16

availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 12 h, RPO 1 h; BIA BP-04 and BP-06 need RTO 8 h: does not meet the BIA (P05 finding 1)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice within 72 hours; no data-return clause
follow_up: Recovery and data-return terms at the 2027 renewal; obtain AI add-on vendors' own assurance (P10)
